Cleaning Agents: Always use cleaners that match the specific material of your shoes. If the surface loses its original luster after cleaning, we recommend applying a professional shoe polish or gloss restorer.
Daily Cleaning: For routine care, use a soft-bristled brush with water or a small amount of toothpaste to remove surface dust from the outer shell. For light stains on other areas, gently wipe with a soft towel dipped in a small amount of rubbing alcohol.
Color Bleeding Prevention: Protect the color of your shoes. When wearing light or dark-colored shoes, please be mindful of your pants and socks to avoid accidental color bleeding or migration.
Storage & Rotation: When not in use for long periods, insert shoe trees to maintain the original shape. We do not recommend wearing the same pair consecutively; rotating your shoes regularly will keep them in peak condition.

title: Simple Project Origami Double-Layer Drape Knit Cardigan
description:
PRODUCT DETAILS
A slim, cropped knit cardigan with a folded double-layer front that drapes like origami. Raw-edge reverse seams and a deconstructed back give it a quiet grunge edge. Layer it over a tank or tee with wide-leg denim or a pleated skirt for an understated streetwear look.
Material: Merino Wool version: 100% extra-fine 17.5-micron merino wool. Cotton version: 100% fine combed cotton.
Features: Double-layer staggered open front, small rolled stand collar, two knit textures and thicknesses pieced together, raw-edge reverse seams with deconstructed back panels, long ribbed sleeves
Fit: Slim fit, cropped length; women's sizing
Sleeve: Long sleeve
Thickness: Regular weight. The merino wool version is soft and warm for autumn and winter; the cotton version is breathable and easy to wear year-round.

title: SS2L Opaque Velvet Christmas Tights
description:
PRODUCT DETAILS
Fully opaque tights with a soft matte velvet finish, made to turn bare legs into a bold block of color. Wear the deep reds and greens for festive Christmas looks, or pick a bright shade like pink, purple or yellow to give a black mini skirt, oversized blazer or Y2K outfit an instant color pop. Pair with pointed heels or chunky boots for a clean streetwear finish.
Fit: One size, stretchy waistband and full-length leg.
Finish: Matte, non-shiny velvet texture with full opaque coverage.
Features: Twelve colorways, including a red split-toe version for tabi-style shoes.
Color: Dark Red, Red, True Red Split Toe, Rose Red, Claret, Green, Dark Green, Blue, Lake Blue, Purple, Orange, Yellow
CARE
Hand wash cold in a laundry bag.
Do not tumble dry; lay flat to dry.
Keep away from rough surfaces and sharp jewelry to avoid snags.

title: Furchin 3D-Printed Pendant Beaded Chain Necklace
description:

title: Genuine Leather Bullet-Hole Snap Bracelet
description:
PRODUCT DETAILS
A wide leather snap bracelet with four metal bullet-hole emblems around the band. Choose from pony hair, suede, polka-dot and glitter finishes. The three-position snap closure makes it adjustable and detachable, for a loud punk and streetwear accent.

Colors: Black Pony Hair, Leopard Pony Hair, Black & White Camo, Purple Suede, Black Polka Dot, White Polka Dot, Black Glitter, Silver Glitter, Candy Sequin

The bullet-hole snap structure can come loose if pulled with too much force; this is a feature of the design, so fasten and unfasten gently
The edges are finished by hand, so tiny marks are normal
The metal parts are paint-finished; paint may wear off with rubbing
